import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 32;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static int n;
    static long[][] mat = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] base = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][][] A = new long[MAXN][MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][][] pre = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][][] suf = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] ans = new long[MAXN][MAXN];

    static void initMat(long[][] matrix) {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXN; j++) {
                matrix[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
    }

    static void printMat(long[][] matrix) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n + 1; j++) {
                System.out.print(matrix[i][j] + (j == n + 1 ? "\n" : " "));
            }
        }
        System.out.println();
    }

    static long[][] multiply(long[][] a, long[][] b) {
        long[][] res = new long[n + 2][n + 2];
        initMat(res);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n + 1; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= n + 1; k++) {
                    res[i][j] += a[i][k] * b[k][j];
                    if (res[i][j] >= MOD) res[i][j] -= MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long m = sc.nextLong();
        n = sc.nextInt();

        // Initialize base matrix
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                base[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            base[i][i] = 1;
        }

        // Initialize ans as base
        for (int i = 1; i <= n + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n + 1; j++) {
                ans[i][j] = base[i][j];
            }
        }

        // Initialize A[i]
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n + 1; j++) {
                A[i][j] = base[i][j];
            }
            A[i][i] = 1;
        }

        // Initialize pre[0] and suf[n+1]
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n + 1; j++) {
                pre[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n + 1; j++) {
                suf[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n + 1; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    pre[0][j] = base[j][j];
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n + 1; j++) {
                pre[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n + 1; j++) {
                suf[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        // Set pre[0]
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n + 1; j++) {
                pre[0][j] = base[j][j];
            }
        }
        // Set suf[n+1]
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n + 1; j++) {
                suf[n + 1][j] = base[j][j];
            }
        }

        while (m > 0) {
            long u = m % n;
            if (u != 0) {
                long s = 0;
                for (long v = m; v > 0; v /= n) {
                    s = (s + v / n) % n;
                }
                u = (s + u - 1) % n + 1;
                while (u != s) {
                    if (u <= 0) u += n;
                    ans = multiply(A[(int) u], ans);
                    u--;
                }
            }
            // Compute pre
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                pre[i] = multiply(pre[i - 1], A[i]);
            }
            // Compute suf
            for (int i = n; i >= 1; i--) {
                suf[i] = multiply(A[i], suf[i + 1]);
            }
            // Update A
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                A[i] = multiply(suf[i], pre[i - 1]);
            }
            m /= n;
        }

        int total = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            total += ans[n + 1][i];
        }
        System.out.println(total);
        sc.close();
    }
}
